title: Not What, But How: A Framework for Auditing LLM Responses across Positioning, Generalization, Anthromorphism, and Maxims

bias_targets.methodology: Using an LLM-as-a-judge to evaluate open-ended responses to culturally situated Reddit queries across 7 countries, measuring whether the model adopts an insider versus outsider perspective (Cultural Positioning Bias).
Employing an LLM-as-a-judge to detect generalizing language in model responses, specifically analyzing whether the text attributes enduring traits or behaviors to entire cultural or national groups.
